examples.featureLive: is feature X live? if not, the exact next actions to ship it

statusCardsResidual.createDescription: One message sets up the whole card: say what you want to watch and what each update should tell you. The agent builds the query from it and writes every update against it.
statusCardsResidual.interestQuestion: What do you want to keep an eye on?
statusCardsResidual.agentHelp: Runs this card's setup and updates. Leave on the default unless another agent should own it.
statusCardsResidual.compilingHelp: You can add instructions and pick an update policy while this runs.
statusCardsResidual.revisionSummaryUnavailable: The full summary text for this revision is unavailable — showing its change summary. The integrated changes below are the live ledger for this revision.
statusCardsResidual.noChangeSummary: No change summary was recorded for this revision.
statusCardsResidual.noSummaryAfterSetup: No summary yet — the first one is generated automatically once this card finishes setting up.
statusCardsResidual.interestHelp: This one message drives the whole card: the agent compiles the watch query from it and follows it as the instructions for every update. Editing it rebuilds the card.
statusCardsResidual.noQueryMatches: The compiled query matches no issues right now.
statusCardsResidual.manualCostNote: Manual cards only cost tokens when you press Refresh.
statusCardsResidual.tokenCapNote: Capped by your {{count}} daily token cap — the card pauses when it's hit.
statusCardsResidual.noOpNote: Only runs when something changed; a cheap no-op check otherwise.
